topic: New contracts and media measurement progress
summary_markdown:
Multiple new business developments were announced, including a signed PO in South Africa. Progress was also reported with Bite (a retailer of telecom services) in Latvia, which has signed a contract for track-to-store measurement and is onboarding a third local visual media player. This partnership will allow the use of data from three OOH media players within one country to measure ad effectiveness.

A separate update shared Mazda's video regarding the CPH case study, highlighting Lidar and Dashboard features.
